videos.summary: agentic: The video reviews the skin as an endocrine organ, the four skin units, cell types, and signalling pathways, but contains a visual transition glitch and a spoken narration repeat.

findings.note: A blank grey placeholder card flashes on screen during the transition between the presenter footage and the signalling diagram.
Narration contains a false start/repeat ('inside... Inside the skin is a local loop') which deviates from the authored text and desynchronises with the burned-in caption.
